messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>

Subject: Discovery follow-up — legal/econ confirmation & PO/onboarding next steps

Hi Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and asks so we have alignment on the vendor onboarding path and decision criteria.

Attendees (from call): Claire A. (Procurement), Tom R. (CTO), Evelyn H. (Redwood AE), Karthik I. (Redwood Solutions).

Key takeaways:
- Decision criteria: reliability (SLA), predictable unit costs, and data handling controls (DPA/SOC2).
- Medisys prefers to run a short pilot (2–4 weeks) before committing to a reserved capacity purchase.
- Procurement will need W9, completed vendor intake form, SOC 2 summary, and an approved SOW or pilot quote to issue a PO.
- Invoices go to billing@medisyshealth.com with net 30 terms; they require a PO number on the invoice.

Action items / asks for you (Claire / Tom):
1) Please confirm the economic buyer (who signs the PO / approves budgets) — we heard CTO but want the name and email to loop in.
2) Confirm the billing contact and any specific invoice references (vendor code, tax id).
3) Attach any vendor intake form or internal checklist we should complete (we can prefill and return).
4) Timeline: when does vendor intake typically move to legal review? Rough estimate (days/weeks) helps us plan the pilot start.

What I’m attaching: Redwood W9 + a short pricing summary and SOC2 one-page. If helpful I can also draft the SOW for the pilot and a sample invoice.

Proposed next step: we’ll draft the pilot SOW and vendor intake form today and aim to return it by EOD tomorrow. If you can confirm the economic buyer and billing contact, we’ll add them to the SOW and invoice.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0178
Redwood Inference

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the tidy recap — very helpful. A few quick answers from procurement: 

1) Economic buyer: Tom Reyes (CTO) is the budget owner for platform infrastructure. He will sign the PO for pilots > $25k; for smaller pilots the Head of Engineering can approve.
2) Billing contact / invoice routing: Lori Billing (lori.billing@medisyshealth.com) — please include our vendor code MED-112 on invoices.
3) Required docs: vendor intake form (attached), W9 (attached — see note below), SOC 2 summary is required; we usually take a one-pager and then ask for the full report only if anything flags.
4) Timeline: typical vendor intake -> legal review -> PO issuance is ~2–3 weeks assuming there are no vendor red flags. If the vendor requires a custom DPA, add another 1–2 weeks.

We are attaching the completed vendor intake template; we’ve prefilled what we had and marked the sections you need to complete. I’ll also start an internal ticket for legal to queue a DPA review once you send the SOW.

Notes on W9: please confirm the tax_id field on your W9 matches what you’ll put on the PO/invoice — our AP system validates that.

Claire Adams
Senior Procurement Manager
Medisys Health

Attachments: vendor_intake_form_filled.pdf, medisys_w9_request_notes.txt

Thanks Claire — and thanks Evelyn for kicking this off. Quick internal notes / next steps from our side: 

- I’ll route the SOC2 summary to our security team for a quick gap check (aim: same-day if nothing urgent). If security requests anything else we’ll list it clearly for your legal team.
- Marissa — can you draft a one-page pilot SOW + sample invoice that includes: scope (1-week smoke + 3-week pilot run), target metrics (latency, tokens/day), SLAs for uptime and support response, and the invoice with MED-112 vendor code placeholder? I’ve attached a pricing summary (internal) you can reference.
- Evelyn — once we have the SOW I’ll submit it to our legal team for a DPA trigger. If Medisys requires changes to our standard DPA we’ll iterate, but we’ve typically completed DPA reviews in ~5–10 business days.

Proposed schedule: SOW draft by Wed EOD (Aug 31), return completed vendor intake + W9 from you by Thu (Sep 2), legal review and PO issuance target the week of Sep 6.

Evelyn / team —

Appreciate the clear plan. We do want to proceed with the pilot. Confirming: I am the economic approver for this engagement; billing contact is Lori (copied on internal notes). We will route a PO once we have the SOW and the vendor intake is accepted by legal. 

Couple of logistics:
- I will have our procurement team submit the completed vendor intake to your team via DocuSign within 48 hours.
- Expect a PO # placeholder (we typically issue a PO number within 3 business days after legal signs off) — we can share the provisional PO number sooner if needed for scheduling.
- Pilot start target: week of Sep 13 (we have resource windows that week). If Redwood can confirm SOW and have starter credentials by Sep 10 we’ll be able to kick off on Sep 13.

Looking forward to the pilot — thanks all.
